bible: RORY: a small, round, cream-white rabbit (soft off-white fur, paler white tummy and muzzle), two tall upright ears with pink insides, small dark-brown shiny eyes with white highlights, pink nose, rosy pink cheeks, a happy open smile; he always wears a short bright red scarf knotted at the neck with one short tail hanging down. He is the main character and the tallest of the three only because of his ears. REMY: a small, round, friendly raccoon about Rory's body size, light silver-grey fur with a pale grey-white tummy and muzzle, a dark slate-grey eye mask with big white-and-dark round eyes, pointed grey ears with darker insides, dark grey paws and feet, and a bushy light-grey tail with dark slate-grey rings; he wears no clothes. THE ROBOT: a small, friendly boxy robot a little taller than Rory's body (shorter than his ears), periwinkle / soft light-blue with rounded corners, a rounded-square head with one short antenna on top, two round dark eyes and a smile, a slightly deeper blue panel on its chest with one yellow and one red round button light, short blue tube arms and legs with darker blue round hands and feet. THE ROCKET: a tall, rounded white rocket with a bright red pointed nose cone, a red band around its middle, two red fins, and one round light-blue porthole window. SETTING: a gentle, sunny countryside of soft rounded green hills under a pale blue sky with puffy white clouds; a winding sandy-tan road; a wide bright-blue river with white ripples and tall green reeds at its edge; a big six-colour rainbow (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) arching over the hills. Everything soft 3D clay style, rounded, warm and friendly. No text anywhere.
cover: Square picture. Rory the rabbit, in his red scarf, stands on top of a soft green hill cheering with both arms raised, beaming. Behind him a big, bright six-colour rainbow arches across a pale blue sky with puffy white clouds. A few tiny red and pink roses dot the grass at his feet. Happy, sunny, inviting; no text.
panels: Rory the rabbit, in his red scarf, stands large in the front in a small puddle, looking up with curious eyes as gentle raindrops fall around him. Behind him is a little cottage with a red roof, with raindrops bouncing off it. Soft grey-blue rainy sky.

Big, clearly visible raindrops are still falling in the front of the picture (the last of the rain, shiny drops and a few splashes in a puddle), while the grey clouds part and sunshine breaks through. Rory stands under the last drops, pointing up happily. Far behind, a rainbow is just starting to appear faintly over the green hills, smaller than the falling rain.

Rory runs down a winding sandy road toward a rainbow far away over the hills, one arm stretched out as far as it can go in front of him, paw open, clearly reaching toward the rainbow. Green hills and a couple of clouds in the background.

The sandy road stops at the edge of a wide river of fast, rushing blue water with white foamy splashes and swirls streaming past. Rory stands safely on the bank at the end of the road, eyes wide and mouth in a small 'oh'. The rushing water fills most of the picture.

Rory sits on the grassy riverbank holding a big bundle of tall green reeds with fluffy brown tips, tying them together with a piece of rope. The tall reeds are the clear focus; a few more reeds grow at the water's edge behind him, and a finished reed raft lies on the grass beside him.

Rory sits on his raft made of bundled green reeds, rowing with a wooden paddle across a wide, calm, bright-blue river with gentle white ripples. The river fills the lower half of the picture; green grassy banks and the far-off rainbow sit softly in the background.

Remy the raccoon is the clear focus, standing on a smooth grey rock in the river and waving one paw with a big friendly smile, his ringed tail curled behind him. Rory, on his reed raft nearby, holds out a paw to welcome him. Blue river and green banks behind.

The robot is the clear focus in the middle of the picture: the friendly periwinkle-blue robot is stuck up to its middle in a patch of soft brown mud on the riverbank, waving both arms for help with a hopeful (not scared) face. Rory and Remy look at it from their reed raft at the side. Green bank behind.

Rory and Remy stand on the bank leaning back and pulling together on one long, bright, shiny red satin ribbon that stretches across the picture to the robot, who is popping out of the brown mud with a happy face. The flowing red ribbon is the main thing in the picture, long and wavy with a soft sheen.

The tall white rocket with its red nose cone, red fins, red band and round blue porthole stands big and upright on the green grass as the clear focus. The happy robot stands beside it, pointing up at it proudly; Rory and Remy cheer with arms up. Sunny sky with a few sparkly yellow stars.

The big, bright six-colour rainbow is the clear focus, arching across the whole picture and coming down to touch the ground in a field of small red and pink roses. Rory, Remy and the robot stand together under it, smiling up at it; the rocket stands landed off to one side, small.

The robot is the clear focus, front and centre, hopping joyfully with both arms up and a big smile. Around it, Rory jumps for a red ball and Remy runs, all playing together on the green grass. The rainbow arches softly in the background with a little colourful confetti in the air.
notes: Rachel to check: (1) Page 2's key word is "rain" but the line says "The rain stops. Look, a rainbow!" — a rainbow-dominant picture invites "rainbow", so the panel keeps visible falling raindrops in front and only a faint rainbow behind; confirm "rain" is still the right target for that page, or consider swapping it to "rainbow". (2) Page 3's key word is "reach", an action that is hard to show in a still picture; the panel shows Rory's arm stretched out toward the rainbow while he runs, but a child may say "runs" or "road" instead (both also R words, so not harmful). (3) Page 4's "rushing" is an adjective; the picture can only show fast, foamy water, so "river" or "water" are likely answers. (4) Rory always wears a red scarf, and page 9's key word is a red ribbon — the panel makes the ribbon long, wavy and shiny so it is not mistaken for his scarf. (5) Page 11: the roses and the red-and-white rocket share the page with the rainbow; the panel keeps both small so "rainbow" is the obvious answer. (6) "Robot" is the key word on both page 8 and page 12. (7) Page 1's red roof is kept from the old art but stays in the background so "rabbit" is the answer.

bible: SID: a small, round, cuddly seagull, soft white-cream body with a pure white belly, pale blue-grey wings and a short blue-grey tail, big round friendly black eyes with rosy cheeks, a short yellow beak with a tiny red dot near the tip, little orange webbed feet. His signature accessory is a little round sailor cap: a white dome with a sky-blue band around it, sitting on top of his head. He stands about knee-high to Sadie. SADIE: a cheerful little girl about five years old, with dark brown hair in two pigtails, a sunny yellow sleeveless dress, and a wide straw-colored sun hat with a sky-blue ribbon band; bare feet or simple sandals. She is roughly three times Sid's height. SETTING: a bright, gentle sunny beach in soft 3D clay style: warm golden sand in the foreground, a calm turquoise-blue sea with small white wave edges in the middle, a clear light-blue sky with a round yellow sun and one or two puffy white clouds. A simple wooden beach bench (the "seat") sits on the sand in several scenes. Beach toys that recur: a sky-blue sand pail, a pink sand pail, and a small red shovel.
cover: A square, sunny beach scene. Sid the seagull, in his white-and-blue sailor cap, stands large in the left foreground on the warm golden sand, waving one wing with a big happy smile. Behind him, a calm turquoise sea, a bright yellow sun, and two puffy white clouds. To the right, a small wooden bench sits on the sand with a sandwich resting on it. Bright, warm and inviting. No text.
panels: Sid the seagull stands big and centered on the sand at the water's edge, wings at his sides, smiling, his blue-and-white sailor cap on his head and the calm sea and sun behind him. He is the clear focus of the page; a wooden post stands beside him, and nothing else competes for attention.

A wide view of the beach with a big, bright yellow sun high in the sky and a broad stretch of warm golden sand filling the lower half of the picture, with soft heat shimmer over it. Sid stands small and happy on one side of the sand; a sky-blue pail rests on the sand on the other side. The sand is the main thing to see.

A wooden beach bench sits on the sand, and on its seat is one big, clear sandwich with bread, lettuce and a slice of cheese peeking out. Sid stands beside the bench looking up at the sandwich with wide, surprised eyes and an open beak. Calm sea in the background.

Sadie, the girl in the yellow dress and sun hat, sits on the wooden bench holding the sandwich in her lap and smiling down at Sid. Sid stands on the sand in front of the bench, looking up at her and politely raising one wing as he asks. Sadie is the clear focus, large and centered.

Sid is the clear focus in the center, happily nibbling a small piece of sandwich that Sadie holds out to him. Sadie sits on the bench to the side, leaning down and smiling as she shares. Sunny beach and sea behind them.

Sid stands on the sand with both wings raised and his beak open wide, clearly singing, with a few colorful musical notes floating up from his beak. Sadie sits on the bench behind him, clapping and smiling. Bright sun and calm sea in the background.

Sadie and Sid sit side by side on the warm golden sand, both smiling, with sand all around them and a little sand sprinkled on Sadie's legs and Sid's feet. A pink pail sits on the sand nearby. The sea and sun are in the background; the sand fills most of the picture.

Sadie and Sid build a big rounded sand hill together in the middle of the beach. Sadie holds a small red shovel full of sand and pats the hill; Sid, on the other side, cheers with his wings up. The golden sand hill is large and central.

Sid gently places one big, shiny pink-and-cream seashell on the very top of the sand hill, holding it with his wing. A small sparkle glows on the seashell. Sadie stands nearby cheering. The seashell is the clear, bright focal point.

A big, rounded turquoise wave with soft white foam rolls up the beach toward the sand hill with the seashell on top. Sid and Sadie stand to the side, safely away, with surprised round eyes and open mouths. The sea is the main thing to see, playful and not scary.

Where the sand hill was, there is now only a flat, smooth damp patch of sand, with the seashell lying on it. Sid stands beside it with a gentle sad face, droopy wings and a small frown. Sadie kneels beside him, putting a kind arm around him. Soft, gentle mood with the calm sea behind.

Sadie laughs warmly and points playfully at Sid, who is doing something silly: standing on one foot with a pink pail upside down on his head over his sailor cap, wings flung out, grinning. A small new sand hill is started in the sand between them, and the sea is calm and sunny behind.
notes:
Things to check:
- Page 2 and page 7 both have "sand" as the key word. Sand works best as a wide setting rather than one object, so check that the child sees the sand as the main thing to name.
- On page 8 the key word is "sand", but the picture shows a sand hill and a shovel. A child may say "hill" or "castle" instead.
- On page 4 the key word is the name "Sadie". Sadie is a human girl, so the picture can only show her clearly; the child has to already know her name from the story.
- On page 5 the key word is "Sid", but the sandwich is also on the page. The prompt makes Sid the focus, but "sandwich" might pull attention away.
- Page 10 shows the sea rolling in. Check that the wave reads as playful and not scary.
- Page 11 ("sad") is gentle on purpose.
- On page 12 ("silly") Sid wears a pail on his head. Please confirm that silly act is clear without being a distraction.
- The old page 1 art put a seashell next to Sid. I left it out so it doesn't compete with "seagull".
- On page 6 the musical notes are symbols, not letters. Confirm they are acceptable.

bible: SHAY: a small, round, cuddly young shark, soft blue-grey all over (#8fa8bd) with a pale creamy-white belly, one big round friendly eye on each side of her head with a white shine, a rosy pink blush on her cheek, a little rounded fin on her back and a small forked tail. She has no teeth showing except a tiny row of soft white bumps when she grins. No clothes or accessories. She is the largest character, but gentle and never scary. When shy she keeps her eyes low, her mouth in a small wobbly line, and her cheek blushes deeper pink. SHIMMER: a slim seahorse about two-thirds Shay's height, lavender-purple body (#c49cff) with a lighter lilac stripe on the chest, a curled tail, a short snout, a row of small pink spikes down her back and a little three-point pink crest on top of her head like a tiny crown; one big round eye and a pink cheek blush. THE CRABS: three small, round, coral-red crabs (#ff6b5c), each about a quarter of Shay's size, with two eyes on short stalks, big round claws, pink cheeks and wide happy open mouths; one is slightly bigger than the others. THE SHINY SHELL: a pale pink fan-shaped scallop shell with soft ridges, small enough for a seahorse to hold, with a few tiny sparkles around it. SETTING: a bright, friendly shallow sea floor in soft turquoise-blue water, with soft beams of sunlight slanting down from the surface, gently swaying green kelp, pink and orange coral clumps and smooth pebbles on pale sand, and sometimes a small far-off school of yellow fish. THE SHOW STAGE: a wide, smooth, flat grey-blue rock on the sand used as a stage, with an orange starfish on one side and a pink starfish on the other. THE SHIP: an old wooden sunken ship resting on the sand, warm brown planks with one tall mast, friendly and not spooky, casting a soft blue shadow.
cover: Square picture: Shay the blue-grey shark swims in the centre of the sunny turquoise sea, smiling a small happy smile, with Shimmer the lavender seahorse beside her holding the pink shiny shell, which sparkles. Green kelp sways at both edges, pink and orange coral on the sand below, soft light beams from above, and a few tiny gold sparkles in the water. Warm, inviting, no text.
panels: Shay the blue-grey shark fills the centre of the page, floating shyly beside a big smooth rock with her eyes lowered and a deep pink blush on her cheek. Green kelp sways behind her and a small school of yellow fish swims far off. Shay herself must be the unmistakable focus.

A big old wooden sunken ship with one tall mast rests on the sand and fills most of the picture. Shay peeks out shyly from the soft blue shadow beside the ship's hull, only partly visible, so the ship is the clear main thing.

Three coral-red crabs stand on the flat grey-blue show-stage rock with claws thrown up high and mouths wide open, clearly shouting with excitement toward Shay. Small curved lines (not letters) puff out from their open mouths to show loud voices. Shay is small at the far left edge, looking shy.

Close-up of Shay in the middle of the sea, plainly shaking her head side to side: her head is turned slightly with soft curved motion lines on both sides of her head to show the shake. Her eyes are low and she looks shy. A strand of kelp sways at the edge.

Shimmer the lavender seahorse with her pink crest is large and centred, swimming gracefully past with a trail of little bubbles behind her. Shay is small on the left, peeking at her shyly. Kelp and coral in the background.

Shay is the big, clear focus in the middle of the page, her eye wide with surprise as Shimmer the seahorse (smaller, beside her) waves a fin and leans toward her, inviting her along. In the distance on the right is the flat stage rock with its starfish.

Shay floats in the middle of the page looking unsure: her body turned half away, eyes glancing sideways, one fin raised to her cheek, mouth in a small wobbly line, gently thinking. Shimmer waits patiently, smaller, in the lower right. Calm sea with kelp. No question marks or symbols.

Shimmer the seahorse holds out the pale pink shiny shell, which is large, centred and sparkling, toward Shay. Shay, on the left, leans in with a wide, curious eye. The shell is the brightest, most obvious thing in the picture; no other shells on the sand.

Shimmer the seahorse, centred, is shaking the pink shiny shell up and down with clear motion lines around it to show the shaking, looking cheerful and encouraging. Kelp and coral behind; Shay is not shown or is only a small tail at the edge.

Shay, now smiling, holds the pink shiny shell up near her fin and shakes it happily; the shell is big and clearly visible with small curved motion lines around it and a couple of little floating music-note shapes. Bright sunny water behind.

Shay is centred on the flat grey-blue stage rock with the pink shell beside her, beaming proudly, the clear focus of the page. Two coral-red crabs at the lower left wave their claws in the air and cheer. Soft gold sparkles float above Shay.

Shay is large in the centre, glowing with a soft warm golden light all around her body and smiling a big happy grin, clearly shining. Gold sparkles float around her. Small in the corners, Shimmer the seahorse and one crab smile up at her.
notes: Page 7 ("sure") is abstract: the old art used a question mark, which the no-symbols rule removes, so "not sure" now rests on Shay's body language alone. Rachel should check that it reads clearly. Page 5's key word "shimmer" is the seahorse's name, but it is also a verb (to sparkle), so the seahorse must be the clear focus and nothing else should glitter on that page. Pages 4 ("shakes", Shay shaking her head), 9 ("shake", Shimmer shaking the shell) and 10 ("shell") all show shaking, so check that the main thing on each page matches its key word. On page 10 the shell is the key word even though Shay is also shaking it, so the shell needs to be big and bright. On page 3 ("shout") the shouting comes only from open mouths and curved lines, since the picture has no words. Shay is "her" in the text, so prompts should not make her look like a boy. Sharks can look scary, so the model must keep her rounded with no visible sharp teeth.

bible: LEO: a small, round, cute lamb who stands and walks upright on two legs like a toddler, with a fluffy cream-white wool body, a puff of wool curls on top of his head, a soft peach-beige face with big friendly dark eyes and rosy pink cheeks, a small pink nose, floppy ears that are pink inside, and dark grey-brown hooves; he wears no clothes. LUCY: a long, slim lizard about as long as Leo is tall, bright teal-green with a pale mint-green belly, a rounded head, a long curling tail, tiny feet, round dark eyes and a pink cheek blush; she is usually lying stretched out along her log, sleepy and relaxed. THE LADYBUG: a tiny round ladybug, bright red shell with black spots, a black head and two little white eyes, much smaller than Leo's hoof. THE LEAF: one big, bright green leaf, pointed at the tip, with a darker green centre vein; it is the same leaf on every page, and when it is a boat it lies flat and curves up at both ends. SETTING: a sunny, gentle green meadow with soft rolling hills and a calm blue lake, a light blue sky with a few puffy white clouds, and a brown fallen log lying in the grass by the water. Soft 3D clay style, rounded shapes, warm and friendly light.
cover: Leo the lamb stands happily in the sunny green meadow by the calm blue lake, holding up the big bright green leaf in both hooves with a glowing smile, a few tiny golden sparkles around the leaf. Behind him on the right, Lucy the teal-green lizard lies along her brown log by the water, smiling at him. Blue sky, puffy white clouds, no text.
panels: Leo the lamb is the clear, big focus in the middle of the sunny green meadow, a fluffy cream-white lamb with a happy face mid-hop with all hooves off the grass. Soft rolling hills and a blue sky behind him.

Leo leaps high into the air in a big springy jump beside the calm blue lake, arms up and legs tucked, with a curved dotted motion trail in the air showing his leap. Grass and a few reeds at the water's edge.

Leo stands by the lake looking up in surprise, mouth in a small round 'oh', as the big bright green leaf lands gently on top of his woolly head. A faint swirly trail in the air shows the leaf drifting down from the sky.

Leo stands by the lake laughing joyfully, eyes squeezed happy, holding the big bright green leaf up in front of him in both hooves, with a few small golden sparkles around the leaf. The leaf is the brightest, clearest thing in the picture.
Leo walks along the lakeshore carrying the big bright green leaf held out in front of him with a big grin. Further along the shore, Lucy the teal-green lizard is asleep on her brown log, eyes closed.

Lucy the teal-green lizard is the big, clear focus, lying lazily stretched out along her brown log by the lake with eyes peacefully closed and a relaxed smile, a few soft floating 'z' shaped puffs above her to show she is snoozing. Grass and calm water behind.

Leo stands by the lake beaming and holding out the big bright green leaf toward Lucy, who is awake on her log and smiling at it, with a few small golden sparkles around the leaf to show it is special and lucky. Both look delighted.

Lucy the teal-green lizard sits up a little on her log and licks her lips with a small pink tongue, the tongue clearly visible at the corner of her mouth, looking hopefully at the green leaf that Leo holds nearby. Leo grins beside her by the lake. No food shown.

Lucy the teal-green lizard is the clear focus in front, on her brown log, smiling up at Leo; Leo stands beside her pointing cheerfully toward the lake with the big green leaf in his other hoof, as if sharing an idea. Calm blue water behind them.

The calm blue lake fills most of the picture, wide and sparkling, with the big green leaf floating flat on the water like a little boat near the shore. Leo and Lucy sit at the grassy edge of the lake, watching it float.

A tiny red ladybug with black spots sits happily on the big green leaf boat, floating in the middle of the calm blue lake, shown large and close-up so the ladybug is the clear focus. Gentle ripples circle around the leaf.

Leo and Lucy stand together on the grassy lakeshore, both smiling and waving happily at the leaf boat floating away on the lake with the little red ladybug riding on it. A few golden sparkles twinkle above the leaf boat, and the sun shines warmly.
notes: Pages 7 ("lucky") and 12 ("luck") have abstract key words; the pictures can only suggest luck with sparkles and happy faces, so the child will likely need the adult's cue rather than pointing at an object. Page 2 ("leaps") depends on the leap reading as an action, not a still standing lamb. Page 8 ("licks"): the old art showed a bun in a thought bubble; it is dropped here so the food does not compete with the licking action, but check the tongue reads clearly at small size. Page 10 ("lake") also shows the leaf boat; the lake is drawn to fill most of the frame so it stays the main thing. Pages 3, 4 and 5 all use "leaf", so the leaf must be the brightest focal object each time. Leo is drawn standing upright on two legs, as in the current art, rather than as a four-legged lamb.

bible: THEO: a small, round, cuddly baby sloth standing upright on two short legs, soft warm tan-caramel fur, a lighter cream belly, a pale cream oval face mask with two dark brown teardrop patches around his big friendly dark eyes, a little dark brown button nose, rosy cheeks, and dark brown paws and feet; no clothes. THEA: Theo's best pal, another small round baby sloth the same size and shape as Theo, but with lighter sandy-golden fur, the same cream face mask with dark brown eye patches, and her signature accessory: a pink flower with a yellow center tucked on top of her head, on one side; no clothes. THE BLANKET: one big, thick, puffy quilt in soft purple with lighter lavender stitched lines in a simple patchwork grid. SETTINGS: (1) outdoors, a gentle green grassy meadow with rounded hills and a single round leafy tree, under a bright sunny sky, which turns into a soft blue-grey sky with puffy dark-grey rain clouds and light rain on the stormy pages; (2) indoors, a cozy room with pale lavender walls, a soft floor, a small lavender shelf, and one window showing the sky outside (stormy grey with rain on the storm pages, clear blue later). Soft 3D clay style, rounded shapes, warm gentle lighting, no text anywhere.
cover: Square picture inside the cozy lavender room: Theo and Thea sit side by side, both smiling warmly at the viewer, snuggled under the big thick purple quilt that covers their laps. Behind them the window shows a soft grey rainy sky with a small, friendly yellow lightning flash far away in the clouds. Warm lamp-like glow, calm and inviting, no text.
panels: Theo stands alone in the sunny green meadow, big and centered, smiling happily; a round leafy tree is behind him to one side. A soft white thought bubble above him holds a small smiling sun, showing he is thinking about a fun sunny day.

Theo stands in the sunny meadow holding a big clear cup of cool blue water with a pink bendy straw, eyes closed, sipping it eagerly through the straw. The cup is large and clearly the main thing, showing he is very thirsty.

Theo stands in the meadow as the sky turns soft grey with two puffy dark rain clouds overhead; he looks up with wide, surprised eyes and an open mouth, both paws raised a little. Two soft white jolt-shaped bursts float near the clouds to show a loud thump from the sky. No other objects.

Rain falls gently from big dark-grey clouds over the meadow, with one bright yellow zig-zag lightning flash in the clouds above to show thunder. Theo stands below, covering the top of his head with both paws, eyes squeezed shut, looking shy rather than frightened.

Close, centered view of Theo standing in the gently rainy grey meadow, hugging himself with both arms, small worried eyebrows and a little wobbly mouth, with a few soft shiver lines around him. Gentle and calm, not dramatic.

In the rainy grey meadow, Thea walks in from the right with a big grin, waving one paw, her pink flower bright on her head; she is the clear focus. Theo stands on the left hugging himself, looking a little worried and turning toward her.

Under a soft grey sky with one small rain cloud, Thea points one paw up toward her own head in a cheerful 'think!' gesture, smiling at Theo. Theo stands facing her with one paw on his chin and eyes looking upward, clearly thinking hard; a soft empty thought bubble floats above Theo's head.

Inside the cozy lavender room with a rainy window behind, Theo smiles with eyes looking up; a large white thought bubble above him shows the big, thick, puffy purple quilt folded in a soft pile, clearly much thicker than an ordinary blanket.

Inside the cozy lavender room, Theo and Thea sit close together, smiling, snuggled under the big thick puffy purple quilt pulled up to their chests; the quilt is large, plump and clearly the focus. Rain shows softly through the window behind them.

Inside the cozy room under the thick purple quilt, Thea sits with eyes closed and a gentle smile, humming, with two small floating music notes beside her. Theo sits next to her with one paw out of the quilt, his thumb raised and clearly visible, tapping it to the tune, with small tap lines beside the thumb.

Inside the cozy room, Theo and Thea sit under the purple quilt smiling and looking up at the window, which now shows a clear blue sky and a small rainbow, with only one tiny pale grey cloud drifting away at the edge. No rain and no lightning.

Back in the bright sunny meadow with a big rainbow arching across the sky, Theo faces Thea with a huge grin and holds one paw forward in a big, clear thumbs-up, the main focus of the picture. Thea smiles back with her flower on her head, paws raised happily, and a small pink heart floats between them.
notes: Theo and Thea are both sloths and look very similar; the pink flower on Thea's head is the only thing that tells them apart, so check it appears on Thea and never on Theo on every page. Page 3 ("thump") is a sound, not an object: it is shown as Theo startled with soft burst marks near the clouds, so a child may say "surprised" or "cloud" instead. Page 7 ("think") is a mental action; it is shown as Theo with a paw on his chin, looking up, under an empty thought bubble, which may be weak. Page 11's key word is "thunder" but the line says "no more thunder", so the picture shows the storm ending (a clear sky with one small cloud leaving) rather than thunder itself. Pages 8 and 9 both use "thick"; the quilt has to look clearly puffy and thick, not like a thin sheet. Page 10 ("thumb") and page 12 ("thumbs") are similar: page 10 is a single thumb tapping, page 12 is a big thumbs-up gesture. Pages 4 and 5 show a mildly scared character; please confirm the level of worry is gentle enough for young children. Page 10 has floating music notes, which are symbols but not letters.

bible: KIP: a small, round, cute young kangaroo with warm golden-tan fur, a pale cream belly and muzzle, tall upright ears with soft pink insides, big shiny dark eyes, a small dark nose, big hind feet and a long thick tan tail; no clothes. CODY: a cute, round, friendly cow standing upright on two legs, a little taller and chubbier than Kip, white body with a few dark charcoal-grey spots (one on the head above an eye, two on the tummy), a big soft pink muzzle with two nostrils, two short curved cream-colored horns, floppy white ears, grey-brown hooves, a thin tail with a dark tuft; no clothes. THE KITE: a diamond-shaped kite, bright red with yellow side panels, a thin white cross of sticks, and a long wavy grey tail tied with small bow-shaped ribbons in blue and green; flown on a thin white string. SETTING: a sunny green meadow of soft rolling hills under a light-blue sky with a few puffy white clouds and a round yellow sun; at the edge of the meadow, a field of tall green corn stalks with bright yellow ears of corn. Soft 3D clay style, warm and gentle lighting, no text anywhere.
cover: Kip the kangaroo stands in the sunny green meadow, cheering with both arms up and holding the white kite string, while the red-and-yellow diamond kite with its blue-and-green bow tail flies high in the blue sky above. Cody the cow stands beside Kip, smiling and looking up at the kite. Puffy white clouds and a yellow sun; no text.
panels: Kip the kangaroo stands large and centred in the green meadow, waving one paw and grinning, his whole body clearly visible with big feet and long tail. The red-and-yellow kite rests on the grass beside him. Blue sky and a soft rolling hill behind.

The red-and-yellow diamond kite fills the middle of the picture against a light-blue sky, its long wavy tail with blue and green bows trailing clearly below it. A couple of puffy white clouds and small golden sparkles around it; no characters.
Kip the kangaroo is mid-hop going up a grassy green hill, feet off the ground, smiling, holding the folded kite under one arm. A curved dotted hop trail behind him, sun and a cloud in the sky.

A gust of wind (soft swirly white wind lines) lifts the red-and-yellow kite into the air above the meadow; the kite is the big, bright focus, tilted by the breeze. Kip stands below holding the white string, mouth in a surprised little 'o'.

The red-and-yellow kite flies very high in the upper corner of a wide blue sky, its tail fluttering, the long white string stretching down. Small Kip stands far below on a green hill, cheering with arms up.
